title: Run the token factory
briefing: You inherit a naive deployment: 140 GB of BF16 weights, batch size 1 — about 10 tok/s and the GPU doing math 2% of the time. Production needs **350+ tok/s** without letting per-user smoothness die, while keeping data movement per token sane. Batch amortises the weight streaming; precision shrinks it. Find a configuration that holds.
debrief: There is no single answer — that's the lesson. 8-bit at batch ~40 works; 4-bit at batch ~24 works better. What can't work is batch 1 (all bandwidth, no amortisation) or BF16 at any batch (the fixed 93 ms weight-stream keeps ITL and tok/s in a headlock). Batching amortises the streaming cost; quantization shrinks the cost itself; ITL is the price you watch while turning both knobs.
